hints = [
    # Direct exclusion of the bad pattern via bit-level constraints.
    # 0xAAAAAAAA = bits 31,29,27,...,1 are 1; bits 30,28,...,0 are 0.
    # crc cannot simultaneously have this exact alternating pattern.
    # We encode: NOT(crc == 0xAAAAAAAA) as a clause ruling out each bit assignment.

    # At least one odd-indexed bit must be 0, or at least one even-indexed bit must be 1
    # (negation of the alternating pattern spread across several clauses)
    Or(Not(bit_var("crc", 31)), Not(bit_var("crc", 29)), Not(bit_var("crc", 27)),
       Not(bit_var("crc", 25)), bit_var("crc", 30), bit_var("crc", 28)),

    Or(Not(bit_var("crc", 23)), Not(bit_var("crc", 21)), Not(bit_var("crc", 19)),
       Not(bit_var("crc", 17)), bit_var("crc", 22), bit_var("crc", 20)),

    Or(Not(bit_var("crc", 15)), Not(bit_var("crc", 13)), Not(bit_var("crc", 11)),
       Not(bit_var("crc", 9)), bit_var("crc", 14), bit_var("crc", 12)),

    Or(Not(bit_var("crc", 7)), Not(bit_var("crc", 5)), Not(bit_var("crc", 3)),
       Not(bit_var("crc", 1)), bit_var("crc", 6), bit_var("crc", 4)),

    # After load, data shifts in — the top byte comes from crc[23:0] shifted.
    # Key: if crc == 0xFFFFFFFF, it is not 0xAAAAAAAA (initial safety).
    # Structural: crc[31] XOR crc[30] relationship — in 0xAAAAAAAA they differ,
    # but we can bound via the polynomial.

    # Pairwise: adjacent bits cannot both match the alternating pattern simultaneously
